ns2:section.sectionText: Restricted to College of ACES until the Friday before fall classes begin; any remaining seats will be released on the morning of August 23. This section has combined evening exams at 7pm on the following Thursdays: Sept 26, Oct 24, Nov 21. This section has a blended format in which part of the content is delivered in lecture and discussion, and part is delivered online. Engineering students with a legitimate reason to take this course may request an override by emailing mathadvising@illinois.edu with name, netid, UIN, and reason. Some seats are reserved for ACES students.
